Unpopular opinion: silent heroes beat talking heroes.

Gordon Freeman never says a word, so you are the one standing in City 17. Link says nothing and still feels like a hero. Players fill the gaps with their own imagination. The Doom Slayer barely speaks and is the coolest guy in gaming. Talking heroes quip too much. Agree?
